faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.header_subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions
faq.contact_support: Contact us via hotline or email
faq.q1_question: How do I register for a TTA E-Bank account?
faq.q1_answer: You can register by downloading the TTA E-Bank app, selecting 'Sign Up' and following the instructions. You'll need to provide personal information, Citizen ID number, and complete eKYC verification.
faq.q2_question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faq.q2_answer: On the login screen, select 'Forgot Password', enter your registered email or phone number. You will receive an OTP code to reset your password.
faq.q2a_question: How do I change my password?
faq.q2a_answer: Go to Settings > Privacy > Change Password. Enter your current password, then enter your new password and confirm it. Password must be at least 8 characters long, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.
faq.q3_question: Are there any fees for internal transfers?
faq.q3_answer: Internal transfers within the TTA E-Bank system are completely free and processed instantly. Please note that you must set up your PIN and EKYC before making any transactions.
faq.q4_question: What is the maximum transfer limit?
faq.q4_answer: Transfer limits depend on your settings. You can adjust your daily limit and single transaction limit at Card > Manage Limits.
faq.q5_question: How do I set up a PIN code?
faq.q5_answer: Go to Settings > Security > PIN, toggle the switch and follow the instructions to create a 4-digit PIN. The PIN will be required for important transactions.
faq.q6_question: Can I change my transaction limits?
faq.q6_answer: Yes, go to Card > Manage Limits to adjust your daily limit and single transaction limit as needed, within the system's allowed range.
faq.q6a_question: What is eKYC and why do I need to verify?
faq.q6a_answer: eKYC (Electronic Know Your Customer) is an electronic identity verification process. You need to complete eKYC to unlock full transaction features and increase your transfer limits. Go to Settings > Biometric to perform verification.
faq.q7_question: How do I temporarily lock my card?
faq.q7_answer: Go to the Card screen, tap the three-dot menu in the top right corner, select 'Lock Card'. You can unlock it anytime by selecting 'Unlock Card'.
